messages:
emily: Heads-up — Nimbus Labs invoice INV-12011 failed several attempts this morning. Customer says their corporate card expired and asked for an expedited wire + a one-time credit for downtime. Seen 2026-05-04 16:17 UTC.
devon: can you paste the stripe webhook/error so we can see failure codes?
emily: pasted below:
```
event: evt_X1nimbus
payment_intent: pi_X1nimbusA
charges.data[0].failure_code: expired_card
failure_message: "Your card has expired."
last4: 1111
card_brand: Visa
three_d_secure: not_required
```
rohit: expired_card + they said they tried ACH micro-deposits and hit same-day cutoff so verification didn't post. If they want wire today, finance needs a manual invoice and we pause retries.
billing-bot: Auto-retries paused for nimbuslabs.io. Manual invoice flow available.
emily: Customer requested INV-12012 (manual) for $15,600 — monthly + overages — and asked for net 3 since they're wiring today. Also asked whether we can grant a pro-rated credit of $400 for a 2-hr outage last week.
devon: For credit, we need approval from finance lead (rohit). Also log credit as a one-time adjustment on the invoice memo.
rohit: ok to approve the $400 goodwill credit. Approver: rohit. Please add memo: "One-time service credit approved for outage 2026-05-01".
payments-ops: Creating manual invoice INV-12012 with amount_cents:1520000 (gross) then applying credit -40000 in adjustments, net due 1480000. GL code 4390. Setting due_in_days:3.
payments-ops: Ops note: when you receive wire reference, call internal API to record payment. Example (ops-only):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/payments/manual" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-12012","amount_cents":1480000,"method":"wire","note":"Nimbus Labs expedited wire 2026-05-04"}'
```
emily: I'll send secure wire instructions and ask for payer tax id + remittance email. Also asked to stop retries on original invoice INV-12011 to avoid duplicate emails.
billing-bot: INV-12012 created and emailed to treasurer@nimbuslabs.ai. Original invoice INV-12011 retry schedule suspended.
devon: Please upload bank remittance screenshot to vault and redact account numbers in Slack.
emily: call scheduled in 20 mins with their treasury. I'll update with bank ref if they send it.
payments-ops: After recording wire, attach bank reference to invoice and mark paid. Then close retry schedule for INV-12011.
emily: call done. Treasury confirmed wire sent and provided bank ref (redacted to AB-REF-777). I uploaded screenshot to vault and recorded note in Netsuite.
payments-ops: Received bank ref AB-REF-777. Recording manual payment now and will mark invoice as pending-settlement. Will mark paid after funds clear.
rohit: confirmed credit logged in ledger and memo includes approver. Thanks team.
emily: thanks — closing thread after settlement. :lock: :white_check_mark:
